title: MoMP workers protest staffing reductions and demand reemployment
location: Kabul, in front of the Ministry of Mines and Petroleum
scope: Single reported ministry-site gathering; national scope not established
organizer: Unknown; participants identified as dismissed MoMP employees
participants_original: Madanyat: a quoted protester said 400–500 dismissed employees participated in the protest; Pajhwok English: ‘dozens’ of sacked workers gathered. Samsoor reports “some” employees and provides no separate count.
threshold_50_evidence: Madanyat body reports a protester's 400–500 participants estimate, but does not clarify whether this is a simultaneous crowd count at the tent. Pajhwok English only says ‘dozens’. Pending threshold review; the 1,209 figure refers to reported posts removed, not participants.

start_date.summary: Pajhwok dates a protest to Dec 14. Etilaat Roz, dated Dec 13, says ministry employees had protested in the preceding days; Samsoor, dated Dec 14, says four days had passed since the protest began. This places reported activity in December but the exact first day and counting convention remain unknown. Targeted English, Dari and Pashto November searches found no November-dated account of this episode; that absence is not proof that no earlier phase occurred. Retain month precision.

end_date.summary: Etilaat Roz (Dec 13) and Samsoor/Pajhwok/Madanyat (Dec 14) report activity on those dates or recent days; none reports the protest’s closure. The Jan 21 TOLOnews retrospective gives no date and cannot prove continuity into January. End remains unknown.

location.summary: Kabul, outside/in front of the Ministry of Mines and Petroleum.

scope.summary: Reported gathering at one ministry location; no evidence of a national multi-location action.

organizer.summary: Organizers are not identified; participants are dismissed ministry workers.

state_target.summary: Demand asks the Afghan Ministry of Mines and Petroleum to reemploy staff and review its state-controlled staffing structure/reductions.

demands.summary: Participants seek reemployment and reconsideration/restoration of MoMP staffing structure following post reductions.

participants.summary: Madanyat quotes a protester estimating 400–500 dismissed employees participated in the protest. Pajhwok English describes those gathered qualitatively as ‘dozens’; preserve both reports and do not convert the qualitative wording into a numerical range. Samsoor says “some employees” without a count; Etilaat Roz gives no crowd estimate.

threshold_50.summary: A protester quoted by Madanyat says 400–500 dismissed employees participated in the protest. The article does not state the number simultaneously present at the tent at a particular moment; keep the threshold judgment pending review. Samsoor gives no numeric count. The new evidence does not resolve whether 400–500 describes simultaneous attendance; retain pending threshold review.

protester_violence.summary: Unknown; neither opened article reports whether protesters used violence.

state_response.summary: Articles report a ministry spokesperson's account of staff restructuring, but no meeting, negotiation, arrest, beating, dispersal, ignoring, killing or shooting. Response fields remain unknown. Etilaat Roz (Dec 13) and Samsoor (Dec 14) also report no direct protest-response action in the portions reviewed; this is silence in the reports, not evidence of no response. The spokesperson’s explanation is not coded as accommodation.

notes: One protest episode is indicated across Dec 14 reports. Madanyat says the protest had entered its fourth day on Dec 14, implying an approximate Dec 11 start only if counted inclusively; the exact first date is not explicit. Pajhwok's English account says a protest took place on Monday Dec 14. Preserve the month-level start and investigate whether an earlier phase began before this gathering and whether the crowd estimate describes people simultaneously present. Do not code the ministry spokesperson's explanation as accommodation. The assigned plan row contains no ccode field; ccode remains null pending coordinator mapping rather than using an inferred code. Targeted November-continuity update: Etilaat Roz (Dec 13) says employees protested in the preceding days; Samsoor (Dec 14) says four days had passed since start. No November-dated account of the episode was located in the scoped English/Dari/Pashto searches. Do not infer no November phase; keep exact onset and crowd threshold unresolved.
open_questions: Did 400–500 people attend the public gathering at once or is this a broader participating/affected group estimate?
What is the earliest date when at least 50 people gathered, and does ‘fourth day’ mean a Dec 11 start?
When did the sit-in end, and did it continue into January 2021?
Did authorities meet, negotiate, disperse, arrest or otherwise respond directly to the protesters?
Does TOLOnews’ later reference describe this same sit-in, and if so when did it end?
Did any phase of this sit-in begin in November? Targeted Nov-specific English, Dari and Pashto searches found no contemporaneous November-dated account, but absence does not establish nonoccurrence.
